description: This file contains debugging extension methods for the CanvasWindowController class, providing test wrappers for various internal functionalities such as sanitizing session keys, generating JavaScript string literals, managing frame storage, and parsing IPv4 addresses.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension adding test methods to the CanvasWindowController class for debugging purposes.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the provided session key.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string into a JavaScript string literal.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts an optional string into a JavaScript string literal.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Generates a key for storing frame data based on session key.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores a frame and then attempts to load it, returning the restored frame.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into its byte components.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines whether an IPv4 address is in the local network range.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local network canvas URL.
